IDQ20855
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Moderate Flood Warning for the Bulloo River

Issued at 11:06 am AEST on Tuesday 3 November 2026
Flood Warning Number: 15


MODERATE FLOODING POSSIBLE AT THARGOMINDAH OVER WEEKEND
MINOR FLOODING EASING AT QUILPIE

In the upper Bulloo River catchment, minor flooding is easing at Quilpie after a moderate
flood peak early Monday morning. The flood peak is now arriving at Autumnvale and will
approach Thargomindah over the weekend and into early next week. Minor flooding is
possible at Thargomindah from about Friday and moderate flooding is possible over the
weekend.

Bulloo River to Quilpie:
Minor flooding is easing along the Bulloo River at Quilpie.

The Bulloo River at Quilpie is currently at 3.97 m and falling, with minor flooding. The
Bulloo River at Quilpie is expected to continue easing, and may remain above the minor
flood level (3.00 m) into Wednesday.

Bulloo River downstream of Quilpie:
Moderate flooding is possible along the Bulloo River downstream of Quilpie.

The Bulloo River at Thargomindah is currently at 3.44 m and steady, below the minor flood
level. The Bulloo River at Thargomindah is expected to rise slowly over the next few days
as flood waters arrive. The river level may exceed the minor flood level (4.00 m) from
about Friday and may exceed the moderate flood level (4.50 m) over the weekend. Forecasts
will be refined as upstream peaks are observed.

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit
www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
The next warning will be issued by 11:30 AM AEST on Wednesday 04 November 2026.

Latest River Heights:
Location                                    River Height   Tendency Time of Observation
Blackwater Creek at Adavale                   0.88 m       Steady   9:00 am Tue 03/11/26
Bulloo River at Quilpie                       3.97 m       Falling  9:00 am Tue 03/11/26
Bulloo River at Autumnvale                    4.42 m       Steady   9:00 am Tue 03/11/26
Bulloo River at Thargomindah                  3.44 m       Steady   10:50 am Tue 03/11/26

This advice is also available by dialling 1300 659 219. Warning, rainfall and river
information are available at http://www.bom.gov.au/australia/flood.
